supplementalCapabilities.status: Implemented delay, session-lock and suspend clearing of the current clipboard; Windows history is not deleted.

Implemented sustained CPU/memory and low disk alerts. Native service lifecycle checks verify idempotent Start, timer teardown and no sampling/notification from queued callbacks after Stop. Threshold/cooldown policy has core coverage; actual notification quiet-time behavior and broader live transitions remain open. Separate NVIDIA thermal alerts are capability-dependent.
Implemented PNG save picker; no Explorer extension.
Per-monitor click-through dimming overlays implemented; monitorBrightness separately provides DDC/CI hardware brightness when the connection reports support.
Implemented explicit folder selection, bounded metadata scan, age review, selected-file recycling and changed-file/reparse-point checks. No automatic deletion or message database access.

Implemented bounded, cancellable JSON backup import/export with a 4 MB byte limit, strict BOM-aware decoding and atomic output. Imports persist an independent normalized copy before replacing live settings and preserve local onboarding/startup separation. Settings recovery retains distinct complete originals, retries refused backups and never overwrites an unrelated legacy temporary file. Fourteen additional core checks pass; native controller/window checks cover failed persistence, successful replacement, pending confirmation cancellation and duplicate/late admission. Full system-picker and confirmation-button/overwrite UI validation remains open.

Implemented four native WinUI steps. Native component instrumentation verifies all 31 selected tools remain inactive before completion through Save/reapply and attempted admission: no feature hooks, clipboard/shortcut listeners, wake timer/request, shelf receiver, sensor services or dim overlays. Selections persist, validation startup stays disabled and completing an empty selection starts no residents. Shared tray/session-message infrastructure is intentional; broader physical accessibility and user-driven onboarding remain open.
English only in this initial port; other language resources deferred.

Implemented NVIDIA temperature threshold, sustained duration, cooldown and no-hardware behavior. Native lifecycle checks verify one timer, stop/stale-callback admission and draining read-only sampling without late notifications. No supported GPU is present on this Dell; real RTX 3080 readings, thresholds and hot-plug remain unverified.
Implemented as savedLayouts: named custom positions, display-relative restore and one-step undo; no Snap engine or custom snapping gestures.
Implemented as windowSearch: title/app search, display filter and activation; no Alt+Tab replacement.

Clipboard/file image pins, six-preview limit, Mica windows, DPI-aware minimum, topmost and close-all are implemented. Native pin layout/capacity/failure cleanup plus production controller feature-disable/re-enable and shutdown cleanup pass. Physical picker, user-driven lifecycle, mixed-monitor DPI and broader accessibility remain open.
